name: Snail Mail Windows constructor-support source runs
notes: These records recover Windows emission-unit provenance for compiler-emitted constructor helpers; they do not replace each helper's authored semantic owner.

windows-constructor-support-run requires a direct source-object anchor inside the run, a closed native caller graph rooted at the constructors compiled there, and a verified different source object at the next run boundary.
Shared folded helpers and cross-cutting platform helpers are excluded even when their bodies lie physically inside the interval.

root_wrapper.notes: The wrapper's outer allocation, size-reporting, and global-publication work is Mac startup code; its verified cRGame mapping transfers semantic constructor ownership from Game.o only to the inlined constructor region. The first support helper begins at the next 16-byte boundary.

source_anchor.notes: The exact v1.5 iOS constructor symbol is STABS-marked in Mac.o and the Windows helper is its verified desktop projection.

ignored_analyzer_fallthrough.reason: The address is the fifth alignment NOP after the process-termination call, not a callsite; Binary Ninja retains a fallthrough edge because that imported termination target is not marked noreturn.

excluded_functions.reason: The mov-eax-ecx constructor is folded across this run and the later SubGame.o global parcel constructors, so one physical body cannot prove a unique source object.
The fatal platform helper is called by startup, audio, D3D, and input/window code outside both enclosing constructors; physical adjacency is insufficient and platform glue is outside this recovery.
